subject: born-again minimalists
one_liner: Team chat for people who have already donated the team mugs.
brand_voice_notes: Dry enterprise messaging language applied to compulsive decluttering. Treat deletion as a governed business outcome. No knowing asides. Every unnecessary object requires a very necessary discussion.

hero.sub: Spare gives born-again minimalists a place to discuss having fewer things. Each channel starts with six message slots. Once full, a new message requires deleting an old one. The conversation stays light. The approval process does not.

features.title: One in, one out for full channels.
features.blurb: On Almost nothing, each channel has six message slots. Once a channel is full, nominate an existing thought for removal before sending another. Other people’s thoughts also qualify.

features.title: An AI with nothing to add.
features.blurb: Our restraint model reduces your carefully written update to its shortest defensible form. “I have some thoughts about the spare chair” becomes “Chair.” Drafts without a recognized noun become “Thought.”

features.title: Proof you let it go.
features.blurb: Every deleted message leaves a permanent, automatic disposal receipt on every plan. Receipts use no message slots. Keep a complete, searchable record of all the information you no longer keep.

pricing_tiers.tagline: Per person, per month. Paid in full.
perks: One disposal receipt signed by a human per month

demo_screen_concept: A working feature preview for the Less, Together workspace, combining six-message channels with AI noun reduction. It is not a single pricing tier. Switch among #the-last-chair, #donation-log and #general-absence. A counter shows slots used in each channel. Write a message; only when that channel is full does a native dialog ask which existing message to release. Confirming removes that message, sends the new one, and adds an automatic disposal receipt to a searchable receipt view. Receipts are unlimited on every plan and use no message slots. Almost nothing also includes a human signature on one disposal receipt per month to certify its removal from the conversation. An AI reduce button condenses a draft to a supported noun, falling back to “Thought.” when none is recognized and announcing that fallback. All data is local mock state, and a reset button restores the sample.

design_direction.style: Restrained flat modernism with an oversized subtraction motif. Cool white fields, oxblood chat rails, pale yellow disposal receipts and generous unoccupied space. No card grid or ornamental gradients.
design_direction.archetype: Product-led messaging SaaS: wide typographic hero with an exposed conversation artifact, open feature rows, joined customer quotations and a subscription comparison. The demo is a channel-based messaging workspace.
design_direction.motion_vocab: 180ms color feedback and a brief opacity change when a message is released. No ambient loops. Reduced-motion removes transitions and smooth scrolling.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Left aligned oversize Outfit headline spanning two lines. Right: an oxblood-framed conversation with two messages and a conspicuously empty third slot, labelled as deliberate capacity. An oversized minus bar anchors the bottom. Headshots only appear with quotes. Mobile stacks the artifact below the pitch and converts pricing columns to vertical rows.
design_direction.design_review: Retained flat design from bundled design-system search. Replaced its floating sky cards and luxury serif pairing because those do not express governed deletion. Selected Geometric Modern from the bundled font library and custom cool-white/oxblood palette. Read the seven most recent concept files; none matches this style, palette and font tuple.

images.rationale: Hero skipped for a typographic composition with a native HTML conversation artifact. Demo assets skipped because the product is a text chat. Three square testimonial portraits make the named household administrators visible without furnishing the deliberately empty product.
